title: Developer Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio built from scratch with Next.js 16 App Router, featuring WebGL shader backgrounds, scroll-driven CSS animations, View Transitions API, full i18n (pl/en), PWA with offline support, and 95+ Lighthouse scores across all categories.
longDescription: A showcase of modern web engineering — this portfolio uses plain Three.js for a fluid noise shader background (no React Three Fiber to keep the bundle lean), CSS scroll-driven animations with @supports fallbacks, and the View Transitions API for smooth page morphing. Built as a PWA with three-tier caching strategy. CI/CD via GitHub Actions with automated Lighthouse audits on every PR.

title: TaskFlow
description: Full-stack project management app with real-time Kanban boards, team collaboration, and automated workflows. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and WebSocket for live updates.
longDescription: TaskFlow is a project management tool designed for small teams. Features include drag-and-drop Kanban boards with real-time sync via WebSockets, role-based access control, automated task assignments based on custom rules, time tracking with weekly reports, and Slack/Discord webhook integrations. The backend uses PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM and Redis for session caching.

title: DevBlog Engine
description: Headless blog platform with MDX support, syntax highlighting, full-text search, and an admin dashboard. Optimized for Core Web Vitals with static generation and ISR.
longDescription: A performant blog engine built for developers. MDX-powered content with custom components, Shiki-based syntax highlighting, and Algolia full-text search. Admin dashboard for content management with draft/publish workflow. Uses ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) for near-instant page loads while keeping content fresh. RSS feed, OG image generation, and reading time estimation included.

title: API Gateway
description: Lightweight API gateway with rate limiting, request validation, JWT auth, and comprehensive logging. Handles 10k+ req/s on a single instance.
longDescription: A Node.js-based API gateway designed for microservice architectures. Features include configurable rate limiting (sliding window), JSON Schema request validation, JWT authentication with refresh token rotation, request/response logging to ELK stack, circuit breaker pattern for downstream services, and health check endpoints. Docker-compose setup for local development with all dependencies.

title: SaaS Starter Kit
description: Production-ready SaaS boilerplate with auth, payments, team management, and admin panel. Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Stripe integration.
longDescription: A comprehensive starter kit for building SaaS products fast. Includes email/OAuth authentication (NextAuth), Stripe subscription management with webhooks, team invitations and role-based permissions, admin dashboard with analytics, transactional emails via Resend, and a complete CI/CD pipeline. Designed to go from idea to MVP in days, not weeks.
